breve: Multiplies a Transform3D and a Vector3 within the visual shader graph.
descricao: A multiplication operation on a transform (4×4 matrix) and a vector, with support for different multiplication operators.

propriedades.desc: The multiplication type to be performed.

constantes.desc: Multiplies transform a by the vector b.
